summary.business_type: Agency / B2B service (national, Spanish-language, online-only: sales calls on Google Meet)
limits: No Google Search Console, GA4 or CrUX access, so indexation and field Core Web Vitals are not measured.
PageSpeed Insights API quota was exhausted; performance numbers are local Playwright lab estimates (390px mobile, 4x CPU slowdown), not Lighthouse scores.
No backlink or keyword-volume data source connected (Moz, DataForSEO, Ahrefs).
The tool's own fetcher refuses loopback proxies by design, so pages were fetched through the workspace proxy and the saved HTML was fed to its parsers.
top_findings: Main site is a client-rendered Lovable app: AI crawlers that skip JavaScript see 24-64 words per page instead of 300-600.
Only 4 URLs in the sitemap and no informational content, so the site can only rank for its own name.
The brand name collides with 'PMU' (Prince Mohammad Bin Fahd University) and 'The PMU Academy': brand searches return other organizations.
Zero third-party mentions found (no YouTube, Facebook page, LinkedIn, directories, or press) and sameAs lists only Instagram.
The English version (?lang=en) serves the same Spanish HTML with a canonical to the Spanish page, so hreflang 'en' is contradicted and English is effectively unindexable.
quick_wins: Add /book and /resultados internal links and /book to sitemap.xml; verify the site in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools and submit the sitemap.
Add FAQPage, Service + Offer ($297/mo) and Person (Adriano) JSON-LD to the homepage and /book.
Fix kit.pmuacademia.com <html lang='en'> to lang='es' and add a canonical tag.
Noindex agenda.pmuacademia.com (paid-traffic funnel) and make its /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml return real 404s instead of the app's HTML.
Add 'Página y anuncios por PMU Academia' footer credit linking to pmuacademia.com on every client site (with each client's OK).

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS on every host, behind Cloudflare; no redirect chains.
robots.txt allows all crawlers (including OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot) and declares the sitemap.
Each route ships a small pre-rendered fallback with its own title, description, canonical and Organization schema.
/ejemplo (demo site) and the booking app page are correctly noindex.

findings.title: Content is client-side rendered; raw HTML is thin
findings.description: Raw HTML word counts vs rendered: home 64 vs 597, /resultados 36 vs 472, /book 30 vs 615, /ejemplo 24 vs 298. Googlebot renders JavaScript, but GPTBot/OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot generally read raw HTML only, so the FAQ, pricing, founder story and results never reach them. The fallback H1 also differs from the rendered H1 on 3 pages.
findings.recommendation: Pre-render every public route to static HTML at build time (vite-plugin-prerender / react-snap style, or move the marketing pages to Cloudflare Pages like the client sites), so raw HTML equals what visitors see.

findings.title: hreflang 'en' contradicted by canonical
findings.description: hreflang en points to https://pmuacademia.com/?lang=en, but that URL returns identical Spanish HTML whose canonical is https://pmuacademia.com/. English text only appears after JavaScript runs.
findings.recommendation: Either give English its own pre-rendered path (/en/) with its own canonical and reciprocal hreflang, or remove the hreflang tags until then.

findings.title: Sitemap covers 4 URLs and omits /book
findings.description: sitemap.xml lists /, /resultados, /privacidad, /terminos. /book is indexable and canonical but missing. No sitemaps exist for kit.
findings.recommendation: Add /book (and every new content page) to the sitemap with real lastmod dates; submit in Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools; turn on IndexNow via Cloudflare.

findings.title: Subdomains return HTML 200 for robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt
findings.description: agenda.pmuacademia.com and app.pmuacademia.com answer every unknown path with the app shell (status 200, text/html). Crawlers read this as an invalid robots.txt and a soft-404 sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Serve a real robots.txt on each subdomain (agenda: Disallow all or noindex pages; app: Disallow private routes) and return 404 for unknown paths.

findings.title: Ad funnel subdomain is indexable with no canonical
findings.description: agenda.pmuacademia.com has no canonical and no robots meta, two H1s, and competes with the homepage for the same offer.
findings.recommendation: Add <meta name='robots' content='noindex'> to the agenda funnel; keep paid traffic pages out of the index.

findings.title: No HSTS or security headers
findings.description: No Strict-Transport-Security or Content-Security-Policy headers on any host.
findings.recommendation: Enable HSTS in Cloudflare (SSL/TLS > Edge Certificates).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong first-hand experience signal: the founder story (built for his wife's studio, Brows By Lexxi) is on the homepage.
/resultados publishes real client numbers (ad spend, leads, cost per lead, bookings): unique data nobody else has.
Clear offer, price and guarantee in plain Spanish.

findings.title: No informational content: the site can only rank for its own name
findings.description: Every indexable page is a sales or legal page. Spanish-language searches such as 'cómo conseguir clientas de micropigmentación', 'cuánto cobrar por cejas ombré en Estados Unidos' and 'anuncios de Facebook para micropigmentadoras' return Spain-focused or English pages; no one answers them for US-based Spanish-speaking artists.
findings.recommendation: Build a Spanish resource hub (/guias/) with pillar pages and supporting articles (see ACTION-PLAN.md content map).

findings.title: No About page and no author entity
findings.description: Adriano appears only as a one-line signature. There is no About page, photo, credentials (years selling advertising to local businesses), or link to Brows By Lexxi.
findings.recommendation: Create /nosotros with Adriano and Lexxi's story, photos, experience and links; byline every article to Adriano with a Person entity.

findings.title: Results page names clients and their ad spend
findings.description: Client studio names and spend are public. Good for trust and citability, but needs each client's OK.
findings.recommendation: Confirm permission; add dates and a short methodology line so AI answers can quote it accurately.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Titles 36-64 characters and unique; meta descriptions 105-160 characters and unique.
Open Graph and Twitter cards on every page, with 1200x630 images.
One H1 per page on the main site.

findings.title: Titles target the brand, not what artists search
findings.description: Homepage title 'PMU Academia | Marketing para artistas de micropigmentación' is good; /book ('Agenda tu llamada · PMU Academia USA') and /resultados target no query.
findings.recommendation: Retitle /resultados as 'Cuánto cuesta conseguir clientas de micropigmentación con anuncios (datos reales)'.

findings.title: Thin internal linking
findings.description: Raw-HTML nav links only to /resultados, /privacidad, /terminos. Homepage does not link to /book in raw HTML.
findings.recommendation: Add a real nav and footer (Inicio, Resultados, Guías, Nosotros, Agenda tu llamada) rendered in static HTML.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization (legalName Academia Growth LLC, logo, email, phone, address locality, founder, knowsLanguage) and WebSite in raw HTML.

findings.title: Missing Service/Offer, FAQPage and Person
findings.description: The homepage shows a priced service and an FAQ, but no Service, Offer or FAQPage markup. Founder is a bare name with no Person @id or sameAs.
findings.recommendation: Add Service (provider = Organization, areaServed US, availableLanguage es) with Offer price 297 USD/month, FAQPage for the visible FAQ, and a Person entity for Adriano with sameAs.

findings.title: sameAs lists only Instagram
findings.description: No Facebook page, YouTube, LinkedIn or TikTok profile in sameAs.
findings.recommendation: Create/claim those profiles and add them to sameAs so search engines can reconcile the entity.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Lab LCP about 1.4-2.1 s and CLS 0 on the main site (mobile emulation, 4x CPU slowdown).

findings.title: 2.9 MB of JavaScript for a 4-page marketing site
findings.description: Main site loads ~2.9 MB of uncompressed JS; the agenda funnel loads ~4.1 MB JS + 0.9 MB CSS and took ~15 s to finish loading; kit has 1.35 s server response and 1.7 MB of images.
findings.recommendation: Pre-rendering (Technical finding 1) removes most of this; compress kit images to WebP and size them for mobile.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI search crawlers are allowed in robots.txt.
Homepage fallback paragraph is a clean, quotable definition of what PMU Academia is.

findings.title: Brand entity is invisible and ambiguous
findings.description: Searches for 'PMU Academia' and site:pmuacademia.com returned Prince Mohammad Bin Fahd University (PMU) and The PMU Academy Essex; nothing from pmuacademia.com.
findings.recommendation: Use one consistent name everywhere ('PMU Academia USA' + 'Sistema Agenda Llena'), get indexed via Search Console/Bing, and build third-party mentions.

findings.title: No off-site brand mentions
findings.description: No YouTube channel, Facebook page, LinkedIn, podcast, directory or press mention found. Third-party studies find brand mentions (YouTube strongest) correlate with AI citations far more than backlinks.
findings.recommendation: YouTube channel in Spanish, client-site footer credits, LinkedIn for Adriano, guest spots on Spanish PMU podcasts and Facebook groups.

findings.title: No llms.txt (informational)
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404. Google says it does not help Search; it carries no weight in this score.
findings.recommendation: Optional: add a short llms.txt once the content hub exists. Do not prioritize it.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Main site images have alt text; OG images exist per page.

findings.title: Funnel image missing alt; kit uses wrong page language
findings.description: agenda 'artista.jpg' has no alt. kit.pmuacademia.com declares <html lang='en'> on a Spanish page.
findings.recommendation: Add Spanish alt text; set lang='es' on kit.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Verify pmuacademia.com in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools; submit sitemap; enable IndexNow in Cloudflare.
Pre-render all public routes so raw HTML matches the rendered page.
Add /book to sitemap; real nav + footer in static HTML.
Fix hreflang (real /en/ path or remove), kit lang='es' + canonical, noindex agenda funnel, real robots.txt/404 on subdomains.
Add Service+Offer, FAQPage and Person JSON-LD.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Rewrite /resultados as a dated, quotable data page.
Create YouTube, Facebook page and LinkedIn; add to sameAs.
Footer credit on every client site linking to pmuacademia.com.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Launch /guias/ hub: 3 pillar pages + 2 articles a week from the content map.
Turn each article into a YouTube video/Short and embed it.
Publish the 'costo por prospecto' data report and pitch it to Spanish PMU podcasts, suppliers and groups.

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monthly /seo audit + /seo drift compare; refresh articles every 90 days.
Monthly AI-answer spot checks in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Mode for the target questions.
Track AI referrals (chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai) in PostHog.
